explanation: The September 2020 document contains highly substantive content: the formal adoption of flexible average inflation targeting (FAIT) in the post-meeting statement, with explicit commitment to allow inflation to 'moderately exceed 2 percent for some time,' and outcome-based forward guidance tying rate liftoff to maximum employment and inflation exceeding 2 percent. The document also notes that growing market expectations for FAIT had already been influencing asset prices over recent months prior to the August 5 break date, making the framework shift and associated communications the most plausible driver of the detected structural break.
